description: Product Concept Design domain — form direction, material direction, CMF, feature/label placement, concept variants, manufacturer brief.
scopeBoundary: Concept-stage design only. This domain does NOT provide engineering drawings, safety certifications, regulatory approvals, or manufacturing-ready CAD specifications. Any client-facing output must carry the CONCEPT_DISCLAIMER string.

blockedBy.reason: De-duplication remediation: duplicate engines removed. Domain logic paused pending foundation layer audit clearance.

integrationNotes: All routes, pages, and sidebar registration entries are EMPTY — do not mount anything from this domain until BLOCKED status is resolved.

The 5 contracts in types/contracts.ts (ProductDesignRequirements, ProductDesignBrief, ProductDesignCompositionMapping, ProductDesignQcProfile, ProductDesignDeliverableManifest) are the integration surface. Teams 11–14 should reference these.
ExistingEngineAdapter (types/contracts.ts) defines the interface Team 24 must implement when wiring real engine adapters.
Pure validators (cmfValidator, dimensionsValidator, componentPlacer, disclaimerService, variantConsistencyChecker) are safe to call from any context — they have no external dependencies.
manufacturerBriefBuilder is a pure concept→brief transformer with no DB or engine dependencies. Safe to use standalone.
The creative-workflow-v2 engine removed from this branch belongs to Team 1 (feature/01-*). If needed, retrieve it from that branch — NOT from Team 20.
mockupComposer belongs logically to the Team 11/12 composition layer. Team 20 will provide a thin adapter once those engines clear audit.
